articles.title: Robinhood is letting AI trade for you so you don't have to keep checking the markets
articles.snippet: Robinhood is bringing hedge fund-style automation to everyday investors by letting AI agents build portfolios, execute stock trades, and even go shopping using virtual credit cards.

articles.title: Three key XRP metrics suggest ‘explosive price expansion’ is next
articles.snippet: Falling MVRV ratio, high XRP Ledger activity and a bullish wedge pattern signal a potential XRP price rise toward $3.10.

articles.title: OpenAI Foundation Pledges $250 Million to Help Cushion AI's Economic Disruption
articles.snippet: The philanthropic arm of ChatGPT maker OpenAI will fund research, worker support, and new models for sharing the gains from automation.
